title: Minimum Number of Rescue Boats with Variable Capacity
problemStatement: Given the weights of people and the capacities of available boats, where each boat can carry at most two people and has its own weight limit, determine the minimum number of boats required to rescue everyone. If it is impossible to rescue all people, print -1.
input: • First line contains integers N and M. • Second line contains N integers representing people's weights. • Third line contains M integers representing boat capacities.
output: Print the minimum number of boats required, or -1 if impossible.
